sections.text:
-Decreases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 80% for 120 seconds.
-Applies Field Protect to the allied Field.
-Target: all allies. Activates Vital Strike (10% chance to increase Damage by 50%) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies World Element (increases max HP by 100%, increases all stats by 100%, increases critical hit chance by 100%, and nullifies buff removal effects and debuffs) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Removes 40 Cost.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
Dark and Star Defense from Unison Damage +500

[Poison Moth] Ren or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
